title: Real Excel import/export UI and in-repo production deployment guide (frontend-only)

requirements.summary: Replace placeholder template download UI with real .xlsx template generation based on selected form fields, including an instructions sheet.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking “Download Template” downloads a valid .xlsx file (not an alert) for the selected form.
The template includes a header row that matches the form field names (and/or display labels) in a consistent, documented way.
The workbook includes a second sheet with plain-English instructions for how to fill the template.

file_operations.description: Add a production-ready XLSX generation/parsing dependency (e.g., SheetJS/xlsx) for real Excel template creation and downloads.
Implement reusable helpers to build and download an .xlsx workbook for a given form definition (including a header row mapping strategy and an instructions sheet).

Replace the current alert-based template download handler with real workbook generation using the new Excel utilities; use selected form definition to derive columns and include an instructions sheet.

requirements.summary: Implement real client-side Excel import with parsing, validation preview (valid/invalid rows + errors), and import of valid rows into the backend while updating import status.
acceptanceCriteria: Uploading an .xlsx file produces a parsed preview (no placeholder alerts) showing row-level validation results.
User can confirm import of valid rows; imported rows appear in the relevant module list (students/enquiries/fees/attendance or the selected form’s entities).
Invalid rows are not imported and display clear error messages referencing the row and the problematic column/field.
The backend records import status in import history so the existing import status queries reflect the latest import summary.

file_operations.description: Add client-side XLSX parsing to structured row objects, plus validation utilities that compare rows against the selected form definition (required fields, field types) and produce row-level error messages.
Implement value normalization/coercion helpers (e.g., date parsing/format normalization, number parsing, checkbox boolean normalization, text trimming) aligned to the form field types used by the UI.

Implement upload flow: parse XLSX client-side, validate against the selected form definition, render a preview of valid/invalid rows with errors, and on confirm import valid rows via existing entity creation calls; then update import status via existing import-status mutation and ensure relevant entity queries are invalidated/refetched.

Add any small supporting React Query helpers needed by the Excel import UI (e.g., convenience wrapper for fetching a selected form definition and/or entities for a selected form) without changing existing hook behavior.

requirements.summary: Implement real Excel export for a selected form by fetching current records and generating a downloadable .xlsx with consistent column order and basic metadata columns.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking “Export to Excel” downloads a valid .xlsx file (not an alert) containing the selected data.
Exported rows match the current backend records for the selected form.
The exported file opens cleanly in Excel/LibreOffice with readable headers.

file_operations.description: Implement workbook generation for exporting entity records to .xlsx using a consistent column order derived from the selected form definition and including metadata columns when appropriate (e.g., record id, createdAt).
Replace the current export alert with a real export flow that fetches records for the selected form and downloads a generated .xlsx using the export utility.

requirements.summary: Add an in-repo production deployment workflow guide for deploying to IC mainnet, including required environment variables and post-deploy verification steps for persistence and Excel import/export.
acceptanceCriteria: A written production deployment guide exists in-repo (English), covering: prerequisites, `dfx deploy --network ic`, environment variables, admin bootstrap token usage, and how to obtain/open the deployed frontend canister URL.
Following the guide results in a working deployed app where a user can log in via Internet Identity and access the dashboard.
The guide includes a minimal checklist for validating persistence and Excel import/export in production.

file_operations.description: Write an English production deployment guide for IC mainnet covering prerequisites, build steps, `dfx deploy --network ic`, required environment variables (including CAFFEINE_ADMIN_TOKEN), how admin bootstrap token is supplied to the app, how to locate/open the deployed frontend canister URL, and a minimal verification checklist for persistence and Excel template/import/export.

Align in-app admin bootstrap token naming/expectations with the production guide (documented parameter name and behavior), ensuring the workflow described in the guide matches the actual frontend behavior.
